verdict.rationale: Terraform is an infrastructure-as-code CLI/engine, not an AI agent with a tool-use loop, so 'plugging MCP servers into it so it can use their tools' is a category error — the evidence instead shows Terraform ships an official MCP *server* (terraform-docs-10/23/36/40) that exposes its own docs/modules/policies to external AI models, which is the reverse (server) role, not client consumption of other servers' tools.
